name: Enthalpy v0.4.21
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.21

## Added

- Use Workspaces to open a local copy, create a workspace, or download one from
  Sync. The same window opens from File, Settings, the command palette, and the
  workspace name beside the tabs.
- The workspace list shows known local copies and their folders. Locate a moved
  folder or remove an entry from the list without deleting its files.
- Unlock Sync with the workspace passphrase after you sign in again. The local
  copy, pending changes, device identity, and pause setting stay in place.

## Changed

- A synced workspace that already has a local copy opens that copy. A missing
  local folder must be located before the connection can be used again.
- Your workspace stays open while you choose another workspace. Creating or
  downloading a workspace shows its new folder path before you continue.
- Workspace name, folder name, and name shown in Sync have separate labels.
- Sync lists refresh when the workspace window opens or regains focus. Local
  workspaces remain available without a Sync account.

## Fixed

- Sign-out keeps recording local changes for later Sync. Sign-in shows the
  passphrase action when a workspace key is required.
- Resuming Sync shows Syncing until the next check completes.
- Returning to a workspace checks its local-copy identity. A different folder
  at the same path cannot take the place of the original copy.
- An interrupted Sync download completes its saved recovery step before you
  can select another workspace.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon. Windows Sync enrollment is deferred until its installed-build
  acceptance passes.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
- Linux packages are deferred.
